title: WinterTimeSnow
description: WinterTime brings the magic of winter to your Minecraft server with stunning, customizable snow effects.
body:
WinterTime brings the magic of winter to your Minecraft server with stunning, customizable snow effects. Whether you're creating a holiday event or just want to add a seasonal touch, WinterTime is the perfect plugin to immerse your players in a snowy experience.​

Features
Dynamic Snow Effects: Realistic snow particles that fall around players.
Configurable Settings: Customize the snow intensity, radius, falling speed, and more.
World-Specific Effects: Enable snow effects in specific worlds only.
Atmospheric Sounds: Add wind sounds for a more immersive winter atmosphere.
Snow Bursts: Sporadic, intense snow flurries for dramatic weather effects.
Performance Optimized: Designed to minimize lag while maintaining beautiful visuals.![Snow effects](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9046c247281dccc7f47ad63c6d1c75927d5a0888_0.webp)
